mapper.sql: select q.question_id, q.question_code, q.content, q.options::text as options, q.correct_answer::text as correct_answer, q.subject_id, s.subject_name, q.chapter_id, q.textbook_id, q.chapter_text, q.knowledge_points::text as knowledge_points, q.difficulty, q.question_type, q.source_type, q.status, q.images::text as images, q.analysis, q.content_hash, q.import_task_id, q.del_flag, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark from edu_qb_question q left join edu_subject s on s.subject_id = q.subject_id

choose.when: order by q.create_time desc, q.question_id desc
choose.otherwise: order by q.create_time desc, q.question_id desc
